rule_plain: Form cannot be submitted without rules acceptance
Rules acceptance version and timestamp are mandatory
business_reason: Explicit candidate acknowledgment before onboarding write

rule_plain: All required fields must be present and non-empty
Email must match minimum valid format
Duplicate candidate by WhatsApp or canonical email must be blocked
business_reason: Protect queue quality and anti-spam policy

rule_plain: At least one preferred time window is required
Tracker detail is required when tracker usage is YES or OTHER
Candidate must be at least 18 years old
Reviewer must be authenticated and authorized
Only SUBMITTED or UNDER_REVIEW can be reviewed
Decision must be APPROVE or REJECT
Approved applications publish deterministic intake handoff for player-management
Closed states cannot transition back to active states
Every submitted or reviewed application includes rules acceptance metadata
Every submitted or reviewed application includes LGPD consent
